name: SEP Draw
subtitle: Security CAD for iPad
promotionalText: Draw IDS, access, infrastructure & CCTV on iPad — export Visio SVG, PDF, and AutoCAD DXF.
description:
SEP Draw is the native iPad drawing studio in Security Estimator Pro™ for security and low-voltage professionals.

Design on-site for:
• Video surveillance with FOV coverage and DORI/PPF estimates
• Access control
• Intrusion (IDS)
• Network / infrastructure pathways and cable routes

Import PDF backgrounds and ASCII DXF. Attach DWG/VSDX for round-trip. Export Visio-compatible SVG, PDF, and AutoCAD DXF. Build drawing-linked BOM takeoffs with PoE and cable engineering checks.

Survey. Design. Defend.

Publisher: NVSSMD, LLC
reviewNotes: SEP Draw is an offline-capable iPad design utility. No login required. The sample project opens with CAM-01 and CR-01 already placed. Use Import for PDF/DXF; Export for Visio SVG, PDF, and AutoCAD DXF only. Screenshot assets in the repo may still be labeled PLACEHOLDER — replace before final submit.

assets.note: Screenshot PNGs are stubs until replaced with real UI captures.
